name: pagination
title: Pagination
description: Long result sets, tables, and search results.

motionProfile.reason: Pagination keeps every destination identity while a visible range grows, shrinks or renames: inserted and removed links fade, retained destinations reflow, the content owns its content-driven height and one active decoration follows the current page only on a readable path.

data.transition/one-shot.reason: The content owns its own opacity entrance and every retained destination owns the opacity channel of its own host.

exit.fade/one-shot.reason: A removed link keeps only an inert, aria-hidden visual at its last committed box until its native removal completes.

layout.move/one-shot.reason: Each surviving destination projects its own previous box; the content measures once and never writes a link transform.

layout.shared/selection.reason: One decoration inside the content follows the single active link and stays inside that content coordinate space.

geometry.resize/measured.reason: The content owns its content-driven block height after a committed range or label revision; passive viewport or font reflow stays native.

state.color/css-transition.reason: The link owns its own surface paint, each plain label span owns its foreground clock and the active decoration owns its own surface; an unprovable caller palette settles that region immediately.

text.change/changed-runs.reason: A direct plain link label, the Previous/Next text props and an ellipsis keep one native text host; only changed graphemes are replaced.
